rooms.title: ACCOMMODATION
rooms.description: With spacious and elegantly designed rooms, SY Hotels offers guests a living space that goes beyond comfort. Feel at home in the sophisticated atmosphere created by modern interiors. Every room is equipped with advanced technology and thoughtfully designed with every detail in mind to meet guests' needs.

gastronomy.title: GASTRONOMY
gastronomy.description: Discover an exceptional culinary experience with restaurants offering exquisite flavors from around the world. From buffet breakfasts in the main restaurant to local and international specialties throughout the day, guests can enjoy a wide variety of dining experiences.

pools.title: SWIMMING POOLS
pools.description: Discover a variety of swimming pools designed for relaxation, refreshment and unforgettable moments of fun. Whether you want to unwind, cool off or spend quality time with your children, our pools offer something for everyone.

spa.title: SPA & WELLNESS
spa.description: Discover our comprehensive spa and wellness center. Release stress with relaxing massage therapies, unwind in the Turkish bath, sauna and steam room, or enjoy a refreshing swim in the indoor pool. Our modern fitness center features state-of-the-art equipment for guests who enjoy staying active.

entertainment.title: ACTIVITIES & ENTERTAINMENT
entertainment.description: With activities throughout the day, exciting sports events and spectacular live performances every evening, SY Hotels Belek aims to create unforgettable experiences for all guests. Enjoy the perfect combination of relaxation and endless entertainment.

aquapark.title: Mega Splash Aquapark
aquapark.description: Featuring 16 different water slides, Mega Splash Aquapark is the perfect destination for adventure seekers and fun lovers. With dedicated areas for both children and adults, guests of all ages can dive into an exciting world of water-filled adventures.

kids.title: FOR CHILDREN
kids.description: Specially designed for children aged 4 to 12, our kids' club offers a variety of games, arts and crafts activities, and group entertainment throughout the day under the supervision of experienced and friendly entertainers.

deluxe-rooms.title: DELUXE ROOMS
deluxe-rooms.subtitle: A NEW LIFESTYLE AWAITS YOU
deluxe-rooms.description: With their spacious and elegantly designed interiors, our Deluxe rooms offer guests a living space that goes beyond comfort.

deluxe-family-rooms.title: DELUXE FAMILY ROOMS
deluxe-family-rooms.subtitle: TOGETHER WITH YOUR LOVED ONES
deluxe-family-rooms.description: Consisting of two connecting rooms, our Deluxe Family Rooms offer a comfortable living space. Ideal for families and groups of friends, these rooms allow you to enjoy time together with your loved ones while maintaining your privacy.

deluxe-superior-rooms.title: DELUXE SUPERIOR ROOMS
deluxe-superior-rooms.description: Specially designed for families to enjoy a comfortable holiday, these rooms feature a spacious and airy layout. Created to meet the needs of guests of all ages, they offer a comfortable living space with modern decor and functional areas.

deluxe-swimup-family-rooms.title: DELUXE SWIM-UP FAMILY ROOMS
deluxe-swimup-family-rooms.subtitle: A NEW LIFESTYLE AWAITS YOU
deluxe-swimup-family-rooms.description: You can step into the water as soon as you leave your room! Thanks to the swim-up feature, you can enjoy the pool without having to go anywhere. Especially for families with children, spending time by the pool becomes even more enjoyable and safer.

deluxe-swimup-rooms.title: DELUXE SWIM-UP ROOMS
deluxe-swimup-rooms.subtitle: LIKE A DREAM
deluxe-swimup-rooms.description: It adds exclusivity to your holiday by offering direct access to the pool from your room’s terrace. It provides a special accommodation experience where you can cool off at any time of the day while enjoying comfort and tranquility together.

deluxe-shallow-pool-rooms.title: DELUXE ROOMS WITH SHALLOW POOLS
deluxe-shallow-pool-rooms.subtitle: A NEW LIFESTYLE AWAITS YOU
deluxe-shallow-pool-rooms.description: It offers a comfortable and enjoyable accommodation experience with direct access to the shallow pool. It is an ideal option especially for families with children and guests seeking a peaceful holiday.

deluxe-duplex-family-rooms.title: DELUXE DUPLEX FAMILY ROOMS
deluxe-duplex-family-rooms.subtitle: WITH YOUR LOVED ONES
deluxe-duplex-family-rooms.description: With its internal staircase design, it offers families a spacious and comfortable living area. Its layout spread over upper and lower floors provides an ideal accommodation experience where you can enjoy time together while also preserving your private space.

deluxe-handicap-rooms.title: DELUXE ACCESSIBLE ROOMS
deluxe-handicap-rooms.subtitle: BREAKING DOWN BARRIERS
deluxe-handicap-rooms.description: These rooms are more than just accommodation spaces. They are thoughtfully designed living areas that allow guests with disabilities to enjoy their holidays while maintaining their independence and freedom. They bring the principle of equal holiday opportunities for everyone to life.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi & Internet
wifi.description: High-speed internet access in the rooms

minibar.title: Mini Bar
minibar.description: Soft drinks, water and beer replenished daily

tv.title: LCD TV
tv.description: Local and international channels and music broadcasts

airConditioner.title: Air Conditioning
airConditioner.description: Centrally operated system with in-room controls

laundry.title: Laundry Services
laundry.description: Washing, dry cleaning and ironing services

ruby-lobby-bar.title: RUBY
ruby-lobby-bar.subtitle: Lobby BAR
ruby-lobby-bar.description: Ruby Lobby Bar welcomes guests throughout the day in a modern and elegant atmosphere, offering hot and cold beverages, signature cocktails, tea and specialty coffees.

lal-terrace-bar.title: LAL
lal-terrace-bar.subtitle: TERRACE BAR
lal-terrace-bar.description: It is the favorite spot of those who want to spend romantic moments, chat with friends or enjoy a peaceful evening with innovative cocktails, a wide range of drinks and special snacks.

marin-shallow-bar.title: MARIN
marin-shallow-bar.subtitle: SHALLOW BAR (+16)
marin-shallow-bar.description: With its cocktails of different flavours and extensive beverage menu in a stylish and relaxing atmosphere, Marin Shallow Bar appeals to those who like to have a pleasant time in the evenings.

aquarius-pool-bar.title: AQUARIUS
aquarius-pool-bar.subtitle: POOL BAR
aquarius-pool-bar.description: With its magnificent location by the pool, you can enjoy a delicious drink while spending time in the cool waters.

larimar-beach-restaurant.title: LARIMAR
larimar-beach-restaurant.subtitle: BEACH BAR & RESTAURANT
larimar-beach-restaurant.description: It stands out with its professional and friendly service approach that makes every guest feel special. You will have an unforgettable experience with carefully prepared meals and personalized service.

sirius-restaurant.title: SIRIUS
sirius-restaurant.subtitle: RESTAURANT
sirius-restaurant.description: Offering fresh, delicious and healthy alternatives to its guests from breakfast to dinner, the restaurant makes your holiday special with carefully selected dishes from international and Turkish cuisine. In addition, it offers its guests a different taste experience every evening with different theme nights.

nova-food-court.title: NOVA
nova-food-court.subtitle: FOOD COURT
nova-food-court.description: Located by the pool and beach, the Food Court is the address for quick and delicious snacks. With hot and cold sandwiches, pizza varieties, fresh salads and ice cream options, this area adds energy to your holiday throughout the day and offers guests a pleasant and practical eating and drinking experience.

bettelglow-patisserie.title: BETTELGLOW
bettelglow-patisserie.subtitle: PATISSERIE
bettelglow-patisserie.description: For guests who want to have a sweet escape, it serves freshly prepared cakes, cookies, cupcakes and chocolates throughout the day. Desserts served with handmade ice creams and Turkish coffee allow guests to take delicious breaks while relaxing.

larimar-beach-restaurant.title: LARIMAR
larimar-beach-restaurant.subtitle: BEACH BAR & RESTAURANT
larimar-beach-restaurant.description: It stands out with its professional and friendly service approach that makes every guest feel special. You will have an unforgettable experience with carefully prepared meals and personalized service.

intro.subtitle: BEAUTY, CARE
intro.title: SPA & WELLNESS
intro.description: It has a comprehensive spa and wellness center. You can relieve your stress with massage therapies offered by expert therapists, relax in the Turkish bath, sauna and steam room, and cool off in the indoor and outdoor pools. In addition, the hotel's modern fitness center is equipped with the latest technology equipment for those who love to do sports.

spa.title: Spa
spa.description: The reception, which has an elegant and peaceful atmosphere, welcomes guests with calming music and refreshing aromas.

massageRooms.title: Massage Rooms
massageRooms.description: In these peaceful rooms, where every detail is carefully decorated and considered, guests can relieve all their stress with relaxing music and aromatic scents.

fitnessCenter.title: Fitness Center
fitnessCenter.description: It is equipped with the latest technology sports equipment and is designed to appeal to athletes of all levels.

turkishBath.title: Turkish Bath
turkishBath.description: With its authentic architecture inspired by Turkish culture and specially prepared scrub and foam rituals, it offers guests a true sense of purification and revitalization.

sauna.title: Sauna
sauna.description: It is a unique place decorated with modern and natural textures where you can relax your body and purify your mind during your holiday.

intro.subtitle: THE MOST FUN PLACE OF YOUR HOLIDAY
intro.title: POOLS
intro.description: Our hotel offers a variety of swimming pools for enjoyable moments and relaxation. Whether you want to unwind, cool off or have fun with your children, our pools cater to different needs and offer an unforgettable holiday experience.

maldives.title: Maldives Pool
maldives.description: Surrounded by white sand and decorated with natural stone details, this pool offers an exotic atmosphere with palm trees and tropical plants.

Beach.title: BEACH
Beach.description: The beach is 2 km from the hotel and can be reached in approximately 4 minutes by shuttle service, which operates every 15 minutes.

Aquapark.title: MEGA SPLASH AQUAPARK
Aquapark.description: With 14 different water slide options, Mega Splash Aquapark offers an unforgettable experience for thrill seekers and water lovers. Featuring separate areas for children and adults, the aquapark invites guests of all ages to enjoy an exciting world of water attractions. Fast slides, a wave pool and dedicated activity areas provide hours of fun for families and friends.

Activities.bannerTitle: A Holiday Full of Activities and Entertainment
Activities.subtitle: A NEW STYLE OF ENTERTAINMENT AWAITS YOU
Activities.title: ACTIVITIES & ENTERTAINMENT
Activities.description: Activities and entertainment throughout the day cater to the expectations of guests of all ages. The perfect environment has been created for those seeking a relaxing holiday as well as those who prefer an active and entertaining experience.
Activities.dailyDescription: Enjoy an exciting holiday with a rich program of daily activities. Whether you love sports or entertainment, a wide variety of activities will make your stay even more enjoyable. Take part in friendly matches and tournaments featuring boccia, darts, basketball, table tennis, archery and air rifle shooting, and experience both competition and social interaction.
Activities.eveningDescription: Make every evening unforgettable with spectacular shows and exciting events. Professional performances, themed parties and surprise activities will bring color, energy and entertainment to your holiday.

KidsPage.subtitle: ENDLESS FUN
KidsPage.title: FOR CHILDREN
KidsPage.description: Every detail of this special area has been designed to ensure children enjoy safe and entertaining moments throughout their holiday, while offering families the opportunity to relax and unwind.

kidsClub.title: Kids Club & Activities
kidsClub.miniDescription: With face painting, arts and crafts, storytelling and creative games guided by experienced instructors, younger children have fun, learn and develop their social skills.
kidsClub.juniorDescription: Designed for children aged 8-12, the Junior Club offers more energetic and interactive social games.

aquapark.title: Mega Splash Aquapark
aquapark.description: With 16 different water slides, Mega Splash Aquapark offers an unforgettable experience for thrill-seekers and fun lovers. Featuring separate areas for children and adults, it invites guests of all ages to discover the excitement of water. Fast slides, a wave pool and dedicated activity areas provide endless opportunities to enjoy the day with family and friends.

HomeRooms.title: ACCOMMODATION
HomeRooms.description: Discover accommodation options where comfort and elegance come together at SY Hotels Belek.

GeneralInformation.title: GENERAL INFORMATION
GeneralInformation.description: With its spacious and elegantly designed rooms, the hotel offers guests a living space beyond comfort. Feel at home surrounded by the elegance of modern décor. All rooms are equipped with advanced technology and thoughtfully designed with every detail guests may need.
